description: Ten sample photographs and three sample clips for a quick natural-domain inference check of the released visual-tool models. Questions and expected answers were written by hand after viewing each file; they are not benchmark labels and were not verified by anyone else.

images.question: What model name is printed on the laptop, just below the screen?
What is the color of the small rectangular object lying below the pen?
What color are the shoes of the man crossing the road?
What animal is this a close-up of, and what color is its nose?
images.expected: A cat; its nose is pinkish brown.

images.question: What object is lying on the table to the right of the laptop?
Which object is directly to the right of the eyeglasses?
What brand name is printed on the game controller?
What color are the flowers, and what color are their centers?
What number is displayed at the top of the desk calendar, and which day of the week is circled?
How many round lights are on the front of the car on the right, and what color are the outermost ones?
images.expected: Six round lights: two large headlights, two smaller lights beside the grille, and two orange indicator lights at the outer edges.

videos.question: What is at the base of the tree on the grassy hill?
videos.expected: A dark burrow entrance with grey rocks beside it.

videos.question: What website address is written in the bottom-right corner of the video?
What is the red-haired character holding while standing in the snow?
